<h1><small>Stage 8 · Prodigy · Lesson 4</small>Flash: ten 3-digit numbers: read-aloud page</h1>
<div class="tempo"><p><b>The beat:</b> one number every 0.8 seconds. Set a free metronome app to 75 beats a minute and read one number on each beat. Say the numbers only, no "plus".</p><p><b>Too fast to read out loud?</b> It is, at this speed. Read the page at your quickest clear pace as a warm-up. Then run the true speed on the flash trainer in the app.</p><p>Say "that is" after the last number. Your child writes the total in the box with the same number. Do not repeat a number.</p></div>
